concrete-repair.title: Concrete Repair, Crack Repair & Sealants
concrete-repair.intro: From corrosion control to cathodic protection, through to engineered structural repair mortars and high strength, rapid setting crack repair solutions –  The ARDEX Concrete Repair, Crack Repair & Sealant range offer proven and durable solutions to guarantee structural integrity for many years to come.

concrete-repair__concrete-repair-mortars.title: Concrete Repair Mortars
concrete-repair__concrete-repair-mortars.intro: The ARDEX Concrete Repair Mortar range provides solutions for new and old concrete repair from high-build hand applied repair mortars to high performance pourable repair mortars. Our high quality concrete repair products offer solutions best suited to your project needs and performance requirements and can significantly prolong the life of the structure. View our range below to find your solution.

concrete-repair__construction-grout.title: Construction Grout
concrete-repair__construction-grout.intro: ARDEX offer a versatile Class-A cementitious grout designed for general purpose grouting applications, with the ARDEX anchoring & dowelling solution purposely designed for dowel and tie bars applications with ultra-fast curing performance. View our range below to find your solution.

concrete-repair__construction-sealants.title: Construction Sealants
concrete-repair__construction-sealants.intro: From highly UV resistance and excellent durability sealants to a multi-purpose high strength adhesive, ARDEX range of sealants have been specially developed for your general construction needs. View our range below to find your solution.

concrete-repair__crack-repair-injection.title: Crack Repair & Injection
concrete-repair__crack-repair-injection.intro: A wide variety of solutions are provided in the ARDEX Crack Repair & Injection range from structural epoxy based resins to innovative carbon fibre crack bridging. This ARDEX range of products are suitable for project requirements such as high strength, superior bond strength or non-corrosive capabilities. View our range below to find your solution.

floor-levelling.title: Subfloor Preparation & Levelling
floor-levelling.intro: A smooth, flat sub-floor is essential for a successful floor covering installation. ARDEX manufacture a range of award winning latex and water-based smoothing, floor levelling and self-levelling compounds for internal and external use.

floor-levelling__levelling.title: Levelling
floor-levelling__levelling.intro: ARDEX Australia has a range of floor levelling compounds suitable for internal and external use. Whether you are looking to level and smooth internal sub-floors prior to the installation of finished flooring, looking for a rapid drying levelling compound, or self-levelling concrete, ARDEX has you covered.

floor-levelling__moisture-barrier-system.title: Moisture Barrier Systems
floor-levelling__moisture-barrier-system.intro: Ideal for use as a waterproofing membrane or barrier coating over freshly laid hardened concrete, prior to the application of floor levellers.

floor-levelling__patching.title: Patching
floor-levelling__patching.intro: ARDEX Australia offer a range of patching compounds and slump free repair mortars, suitable for creating new ramps, forming covers, patch repairs, filling cracks, and the installation of floor coverings.

floor-levelling__repair-mortars.title: Repair Mortars
floor-levelling__repair-mortars.intro: ARDEX Australia’s range of repair mortars are rapid drying and ideal for creating new ramps, forming coves, patch repairs, and filling cracks. Suitable to repair concrete internally and externally.

floor-levelling__screeds.title: Screeds
floor-levelling__screeds.intro: Looking for screed cement for internal and external use, to achieve falls for water run-off and level uneven floors prior to tiling or waterproofing? ARDEX Australia has screeding options designed for all types of floor coverings.

floor-levelling__smoothing.title: Smoothing
floor-levelling__smoothing.intro: ARDEX Australia have a range of smoothing concrete suitable for internal and external use. For a smooth, permanent finish to a variety of internal substrates prior to the installation of floorcoverings, choose ARDEX.

flooring-adhesives.title: Flooring Adhesives
flooring-adhesives.intro: Looking for optimum emissions with low VOC emissions? ARDEX resilient adhesives are your best choice. Whether it’s carpet, vinyl or linoleum, ARDEX has the specialist products for these and many other floor coverings. They not only offer perfect adhesion but are also free of solvents and extremely low on emissions. And with ARDEX SpeedTec technology, we’re now entering a whole new dimension in speed. ARDEX SpeedTec brings to ARDEX floor covering adhesives the speed you’re familiar with from ARDU

primers-bonding-agents-additives.title: Primers, Bonding Agents & Additives
primers-bonding-agents-additives.intro: The key to success when installing ARDEX products is to achieve a good bond between the substrate and ARDEX floor levelling cements, waterproofing membranes and tile adhesives. ARDEX produce a range of primers for internal and external use

render.title: Render
render.intro: From general purpose acrylic based render to fibre-reinforced modified renders with superior non-slump performance and excellent impact resistance, ARDEX have the render solution for your next project.

render__cement-render.title: Cement Render
render__cement-render.intro: With superior non-slump performance, excellent impact resistance, and suitability for both internal and external applications, the ARDEX render range has your solution. View our range below to find your solution.

render__render-primers-additives.title: Render Primers & Additives
render__render-primers-additives.intro: ARDEX offer primer and additives to enhance bond strength, improve water resistance, and increase both working time and product flexibility for cement based render. View our range below to find your solution.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems.title: Tile & Stone Installation Systems
tile-and-stone-installation-systems.intro: ARDEX provides intelligent and trusted system solutions for every aspect of tiling. For tile and natural stone installations – indoors and outdoors – domestic and commercial projects. ARDEX tile & stone installation systems include products for levelling, under tile waterproofing, tile adhesives, grouts, silicones, sealers and cleaners.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__epo.title: Epoxy Systems
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__epo.intro: ARDEX offer high performance epoxy grouts designed to suit all ceramic and porcelain tiles, terrazzo, slate, quarry tiles, glass, and natural stone, in areas that require strict standards of hygiene.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__nat.title: Natural Stone Systems
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__nat.intro: ARDEX offer a range of natural stone solutions, specially designed for fixing natural stone such as marble and granite, including those sensitive to moisture. Suitable for a range of substrates including concrete, screeds, existing ceramic tiles, and Autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC). View our range below.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__sil.title: Silicones
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__sil.intro: ARDEX silicones are suitable for use with ceramic tiles, glass, enamel, granite, porcelain, and moisture sensitive natural stone prone to staining, such as marble, granite, sandstone, and limestone. View the range below.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__sou.title: Sound-Deadening
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__sou.intro: ARDEX offer an acoustic mat solution designed to effectively reduce impact sound, which can be installed onto various substrates prior to the direct application of tiles, slabs, natural stone, and concrete pavers.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.title: Tile Adhesives
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.intro: ARDEX manufacture a comprehensive range of floor and wall tile adhesives, from convenient ready for use products, to powder based adhesives designed specifically for use with large format tile or natural stone installations.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.title: Powdered Adhesives
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.intro: Fibre Reinforced Flexible Non Slump Wall and Floor Tile Adhesive

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.title: Ready Mixed Adhesives
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.intro: ARDEX CA 20 P Plus is a one component, silane modified polymer adhesive.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.title: Tile Grouts
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.intro: Choose the best grout for either a contrasting or complementary finish. View ARDEX’s range of epoxy and cement-based grouts, available in a wide range of colours, and suitable for both wall and floor tiling. ARDEX has a complete grout system for indoor and outdoor applications.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__til.intro: The key to success when installing ARDEX products is to achieve a good bond between the substrate and ARDEX floor levelling cements, waterproofing membranes and tile adhesives. ARDEX produce a range of primers for internal and external use.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__unc.intro: ARDEX offers a range of uncoupling and decoupling systems, ideal for large format tiles in high traffic areas. Suitable for a range of substrates, including concrete, timber subfloors, vinyl floor coverings and existing and cracked tiles. Designed for internal applications only.

tile-and-stone-installation-systems__und.title: Undertile Waterproofing
tile-and-stone-installation-systems__und.intro: Looking for suitable waterproofing membranes designed for use under tiles? ARDEX Australia has a range of high performance undertile waterproofing membranes, with good adhesion with ARDEX tile adhesives and suitable for both floors and walls.

tile-grouts.title: Tile Grouts
tile-grouts.intro: Choose the best grout for either a contrasting or complementary finish. View ARDEX’s range of epoxy and cement-based grouts, available in a wide range of colours, and suitable for both wall and floor tiling. ARDEX has a complete grout system for indoor and outdoor applications.

tile-grouts__cement-based-grouts.intro: Flexible Coloured Grout for Tile Joints 1 to 8 mm Wide (Please note: FG 8 Colour No. 200 White is no longer being produced and will be replaced by No. 201 Kosciuszko White, which will be available from February 2026.)

waterproofing-roofing-membranes.title: Waterproofing & Roofing Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes.intro: Specially designed for total reliability and superior performance for below grade through to exposed roofing applications, supported by market leading innovative technology, ARDEX provides specific waterproofing solutions for your project needs.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__below-g.title: Below Grade Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__below-g.intro: From below ground carparks and lift pits to retaining walls and planter box applications, ARDEX provides the complete waterproofing system for your next project. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__butynol.title: Butynol Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__butynol.intro: ARDEX Butynol membranes have been trusted for over 50 years for a variety of applications. With properties that resist ageing from heat, sunlight, and ozone, and renowned for its strength and versatility the ARDEX Butynol range are designed and proven to meet your project needs. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__externa.title: Protective Facade Coatings
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__externa.intro: From concrete repair to protective façade coatings, ARDEX offer the complete façade restoration solution. Our protective coatings are specifically engineered to ensure your structure is protected against chloride ions, sulphide ion, and carbonation attack for many years to come. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__externa.title: External Roof/Deck Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__externa.intro: With a wide range of liquid applied, single ply, and multi-layer applied membranes ARDEX offers a variety of waterproofing solutions. From trafficable to UV resistant products with excellent flexibility and durability, you will find your solution in our market leading innovative waterproofing range. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__prepara.title: Preparatory Products & Primers
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__prepara.intro: From primers to create a superior bond strength through to additives to ensure increase product workability and flexural strength, ARDEX have the product accessory to meet your project needs. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__torch-a.title: Torch Applied Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__torch-a.intro: The versatile ARDEX torch applied membrane range are suitable for both vertical and horizontal applications across a multitude of environments. waterproofing-roofing-membranes__underti.title: Internal Undertile Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__underti.intro: Our complete systems approach allows ARDEX to offer a comprehensive range of liquid applied and sheet applied membranes for all your internal waterproofing applications. View our range below to find your solution.

waterproofing-roofing-membranes__weldtec.title: Weldtec Membranes
waterproofing-roofing-membranes__weldtec.intro: The ARDEX Weldtec range offers one of the most comprehensive and innovative waterproofing solutions available today. With unparalleled performance and market leading solutions for below grade applications through to rooftop environments, the ARDEX Weldtec range has the system to meet your project needs. View our range below to find your solution.

wedi__building-systems.intro: Design & variety – It all begins with the wedi building board.
